text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1061, Starfish Front Door Knocker in Brass

The Large Polished Brass Starfish Door Knocker is beautifully detailed. The polished brass and bronze finish really helps to bring out this front door knocker's exquisite artistry. It can be surface mounted to wood or metal doors and comes packaged with all the necessary hardware. This Polished Brass Premium Starfish Door Knocker is large enough to hold its own even on big doors.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Also Available: smaller 4-3/4" Polished Brass Starfish Door Knocker

Features and Specifications of the Polished Brass Starfish Premium Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass and Bronze
  • Height: 6-1/2"
  • Width: 6-3/4"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 2-1/8"
  • Projection Off Door: 2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Available in 2 finishes:
Polished Brass and Bronze Nickel Silver

Sold Individually
